art_direction: Luxurious Black, Gold, and White. Premium, authoritative, artistic. Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level.

gradients.gold_text: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-[#BF953F] via-[#FCF6BA] to-[#B38728]

visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Add a fixed full-screen div with a subtle SVG noise filter to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.hover_effects: Optical clarity. Borders glow subtly with gold on hover, image containers scale slightly (1.05) with 0.6s ease-out.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section vertical padding. gap-8 to gap-16 for grids.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For services: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Mix spans (e.g., col-span-4 row-span-2, col-span-8 row-span-1) to create asymmetry.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align headings for editorial tension. Never center everything.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. bg-[#D4AF37] text-black font-semibold hover:bg-[#F3E5AB] transition-colors duration-300 px-8 py-4
buttons.outline: Border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37] hover:text-black transition-all duration-300 px-8 py-4 backdrop-blur-sm

components.cards: Raw HTML/Tailwind divs. bg-surface_elevated border border-white/5 hover:border-[#D4AF37]/50 transition-colors p-8. No Shadcn default cards for marketing sections.
components.inputs: Shadcn input/textarea but heavily customized: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 rounded-none focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:border-[#D4AF37] px-0 text-lg placeholder:text-muted transition-colors. Do not use standard boxes.
components.accordion: Shadcn accordion. Border-b only. Title text-2xl font-serif. Hover text-gold.

patterns.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal for H1. Staggered fade up for subtitle and CTA.
patterns.scroll_reveal: whileInView={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }} initial={{ y: 40, opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
patterns.parallax: Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform for subtle image y-axis shift.
patterns.momentum_scroll: Wrap the app in Lenis root for buttery smooth momentum scrolling.

guidelines: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-quote-btn').
Ensure minimum contrast ratio (APCA). Use text-shadow if placing text over images.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans-serif for headings. Stick to Playfair Display or Cinzel.
CRITICAL: 100% French content. DO NOT use English placeholders.
CRITICAL: No Shadcn default styled Cards. Build raw custom HTML/Tailwind for artistic marketing sections.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use a fully transparent background on the sticky nav. Use backdrop-blur with bg-black/70.
Integrate @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth scrolling at the root App level.
Forms must use Shadcn components but stripped of Vercel/Bootstrap look. Use border-bottom only for inputs (minimalist editorial look).
Only use the exact color palette (Black, Gold, White). Do not inject random colors.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp).
NEVER use emoji characters (🤖🧠) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
